descriptors.definition: Fiscal statutes compute tax liability on an ad-valorem basis using a prescribed valuation mechanism for goods and services. The transaction value between unrelated parties acts as the default taxable base under statutory valuation provisions.
instrument_references: Chapter IV of the CGST Rules, 2017
inclusion: CGST, SGST, UTGST, and IGST computation frameworks
exclusion: Transactions where price is not the sole consideration
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes standard transaction value pricing from specialized rule-based valuation methods used when standard criteria fail.

descriptors.definition: Statutory definitions establish specific legal meanings for agents, consideration, family dependents, goods, and market value within the indirect tax framework. Deposits are excluded from consideration unless explicitly applied by the supplier as payment.
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes held security deposits from active payment consideration based on supplier application timing.

descriptors.definition: The taxable value of a supply equals its transaction value when parties are unrelated and price is the sole consideration. Additions such as incidental expenses, recipient liabilities, non-government subsidies, and taxes are included, while qualifying pre- and post-supply discounts are excluded.
inclusion: Separate third-party levies other than specified GST laws
Delayed payment interest, late fees, and penalties
exclusion: Discounts recorded on invoices or linked via pre-supply agreements with reversed ITC
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts mandatory additions to the price with permitted exclusions like conditional discounts and government subsidies.

descriptors.definition: Valuation rules determine taxable values when consideration is not wholly in money or when transactions occur between distinct or related persons. The process follows a hierarchical methodology starting with open market value and falling back to like-kind quality or computed cost rules.
inclusion: Supplies between distinct establishments or related entities
exclusion: Standard arm-length transactions where price is the sole monetary consideration under section 15(1)
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates default transaction pricing from sequential fallback valuation rules applied during non-monetary or related-party transactions.
